verdict.rationale: Persona explicitly offers a Hosted Flow ("redirect users to a Persona-hosted page... no frontend code required") which supports the no-code link concept for one-off verifications (persona-docs-8, persona-docs-11, persona-docs-30). However, there is no evidence of a QR-code generation feature, nor of a dashboard workflow letting an ops lead self-serve create a one-off invite without any engineering/API involvement (pre-creating inquiries is described via the API, persona-docs-18). missing for 10: QR code support, ops-only dashboard link generation without any API/engineering step.
